_about: Shared identity layer for Baby Hoover V2 (Booth, Gallery, Pit Wall). Keyed on driver_id; handle/network_id/race_number are match fields. Scaffolded from HOOVER_20260908_202102 s11; AI cars resolve from telemetry and are not listed. Car 19 ran as 'Player' (no handle, race number 0) and must be matched by operator assignment or by enabling online names.

drivers._note: Set spoken.full to the driver's real name and level to 'A' to unlock full-name intros, possessives and personal lines.
